name: Teachers
description: Written by and starring acclaimed comedy troupe The Katydids, Teachers shows their hilariously warped perspective as six elementary school teachers trying to mold young minds, even though their own lives aren’t really together.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: The teachers are put in charge of preventing bullying at Fillmore; Mrs. Adler confronts her past as a tortured teen.

videos.title: Picture Day
videos.overview: All of the teachers try to look their best for picture day, but fate seems to work against them.

videos.title: Duct Duct Goose
videos.overview: When the Superintendent visits, everyone tries to be on their best behavior. Ms. Snap auditions for ''The Bachelor.''

videos.title: Hall of Shame
videos.overview: Ms. Snap tries to keep her hookup a secret. Ms. Bennigan teaches a different kind of science.

videos.title: Jacob
videos.overview: Ms. Watson considers that her ex may have moved on. Ms. Cannon tries to put an end to cliques among teachers.

videos.title: Drunk Kiss
videos.overview: Ms. Bennigan begins to question everything after a drunken moment at the bar. Ms. Feldman is overly honest on her health questionnaire.

videos.title: Bad Tweeter
videos.overview: Ms. Snap gets in trouble after a tweet. Ms. Feldman tries to urge a shy girl out of her shell.

videos.title: Sex Ed
videos.overview: Ms. Bennigan must teach a subject she is not comfortable with. Ms. Snap must battle a helicopter parent.

videos.title: Hot Lunch
videos.overview: Mrs. Adler is finally able to get parent volunteers, but for the wrong reasons. Ms. Snap has a new student.

videos.title: Last Day
videos.overview: The teachers have survived another school year. Ms. Cannon questions her worth when there is a lack of gifts from her students.

videos.title: First Day Back
videos.overview: Ms. Watson tries a premium online dating service; Ms. Snap learns she's teaching the worst group of kids in the school; Mrs. Alder is assigned a mobile classroom.

videos.title: Stranger Danger
videos.overview: New security is hired after a trespasser hits Fillmore. A “Women Empowering Women” workshop is held by Ms. Snap and Ms. Bennigan. Mrs. Adler takes the concept of "stranger danger" too far. Ms. Watson buys a male safety dummy.

videos.title: School Sweet School
videos.overview: Mrs. Adler moves into a tiny house with her husband. Ms. Cannon's jewelry shop goes under and Ms. Watson and Ms. Snap try to boost her spirits. Ms. Feldman fakes a lesson; and Ms. Bennigan struggles with a student.

videos.title: Held Back
videos.overview: Ms. Bennigan learns Hot Dad's son has to repeat second grade. Ms. Snap brings her dog to school as a therapy dog. when Ms. Feldman has to teach her students Common Core, she discovers it's more complicated than she thought.

videos.title: Snap Judgement
videos.overview: Ms. Snap decides to run for School Council and is thrown into a world of double standards. Ms. Bennigan, Mrs. Adler, Ms. Feldman, and Ms. Cannon help with the campaign, but Ms. Watson takes longer to get on board.

videos.title: Brokebitch Mountain
videos.overview: Ms. Feldman can't make ends meet on her salary and takes a second job. Ms. Watson notices a romantic spark between two of her second grade students. the teachers take advantage of Principal Pearson.

videos.title: Thirty-One and Done
videos.overview: Ms. Snap struggles with the idea of turning 31 and tries to regain her youth. Ms. Bennigan offers to baby-sit Blake for Hot Dad. the teachers deal with every teacher's nightmare when the copier breaks down.

videos.title: Getting Drilled
videos.overview: When a tornado touches down near Fillmore, procedures go out the window as the teachers panic. Horrified by their negligence, Principal Pearson puts the teachers on probation until they complete a team-building course.

videos.title: In Security
videos.overview: Mrs. Adler coaches kickball and Principal Pearson discovers the teachers' skeletons in the janitor's closet after reviewing security footage.

videos.title: Lunchtime! The Musical
videos.overview: Ms. Snap changes the school lunch menu while Ms. Feldman starts an underground junk food ring; Hot Dad volunteers for lunch duty and Ms. Bennigan works up the nerve to ask him out on a real date.

videos.title: Dosey Don't
videos.overview: Ms. Bennigan is worried that Hot Dad is back together with his ex-wife. Meanwhile, Ms. Snap uses the school dance to impress a famous radio host.

videos.title: Passive Eggressive
videos.overview: A trip to the gynecologist sends Ms. Watson and her ticking biological clock into a tailspin, while Ms. Cannon and Ms. Snap prepare for the dreaded standardized testing.

videos.title: Dire Straights
videos.overview: Ms. Feldman struggles between her budding romance with Fillmore's new anti-drug officer and her love of marijuana. Ms. Watson becomes addicted to bingo. Mrs. Adler wreaks havoc when she tries to quit smoking.

videos.title: Nightmare on Fillmore Street
videos.overview: When the Wi-Fi goes out, Ms. Snap is forced to go into the forgotten and seemingly haunted library in order to get a book. Ms. Watson has a confusing dream about Principal Pearson.

videos.title: Hot Date
videos.overview: Ms. Bennigan decides to ask Hot Dad out during a chicken pox epidemic at the school. Ms. Snap discovers she has a gender bias.

videos.title: Let It Flow
videos.overview: Ms. Cannon discovers that one of her students is an artistic prodigy. Mrs. Adler and Ms. Watson take the mini-society competition to a new level.

videos.title: Third Wheel
videos.overview: Ms. Snap and Ms. Bennigan's relationship is tested when Ms. Bennigan and Hot Dad become official. Ms. Feldman and Mrs. Adler go on the hunt for Fillmore's most disturbing troublemaker.

videos.title: Toxic Workplace
videos.overview: Tensions run high between the teachers as the school year ends; asbestos is discovered in Mrs. Adler's trailer.

videos.title: Don't Go Pranking My Heart
videos.overview: Ms. Watson and Principal Pearson struggle with balancing their new romantic relationship at work; Ms. Feldman takes April Fools' Day too far.

videos.title: Labor Pains
videos.overview: Mrs. Adler announces she's pregnant; back in time, during the 1940s, the women of Fillmore fight for better treatment at work.

videos.title: Hello, Goodbye
videos.overview: Back from summer break, Mrs. Adler discovers an unwanted visitor in her trailer. Ms. Watson finds herself newly poor, putting the Back to School Mixer in jeopardy.

videos.title: All by Myselfie
videos.overview: Toby Pearson learns how hard it is to be a teacher again. Ms. Snap launches a campaign to ban selfies. A pregnant Mrs. Adler garners attention from a doting student.

videos.title: Of Lice and Men
videos.overview: Ms. Bennigan wrestles with how far she is willing to go sexually with Hot Dad. Ms. Cannon learns how to drive in the midst of an apocalyptic lice outbreak at Fillmore.

videos.title: Leggo My Preggo
videos.overview: Mrs. Adler has had it with everyone who has an opinion about her pregnancy; Ms. Watson joins a makeup pyramid scheme; Ms. Bennigan gets caught in the middle of disputing custody parents.

videos.title: Gender Bender
videos.overview: The field trip is delayed when a student goes missing; Ms. Cannon helps Mrs. Adler cope with the gender of her baby; Ms. Watson deals with a student's imaginary friend.

videos.title: Wake and Blake
videos.overview: Teachers show their hilariously warped perspective as six elementary school educators trying to mold young minds, even though their own lives aren't really together hah hihah.

videos.title: The Book Challenge
videos.overview: Teachers show their hilariously warped perspective as six elementary school educators trying to mold young minds, even though their own lives aren't really together.

videos.title: For Poorer or Poorer
videos.overview: Ms. Watson gets evicted and Toby lets her move in to his place. Ms. Snap joins a dating website for well-to-do older men. Ms. Bennigan deals with the awkwardness of seeing a student outside of school.

videos.title: Step by Stepsister
videos.overview: Ms. Snap is surprised when her mother, Tanya, shows up at a parent-teacher conference. Ms. Watson and Toby prepare a tap dance routine for the talent show. Ms. Cannon forces students to perform a song that will save Mother Earth.

videos.title: Hot Deadly Dad
videos.overview: Ms. Snap convinces Ms. Bennigan that Hot Dad is a serial killer who is still at large in Chicago. Ms. Watson attempts to teach her dirtbag student to be upper class. Ms. Cannon wears leggings that leave little to the imagination.

videos.title: Thoughts and Bears
videos.overview: Fillmore Elementary School's new neighbor owns something dangerous that alarms the teachers. Ms. Watson finally has to face Toby.

videos.title: Operation Egg Drop
videos.overview: Ms. Snap contemplates motherhood and the possibility of freezing her eggs. Ms. Bennigan battles technology in the classroom. Ms. Watson pressures her students to win the science fair.

videos.title: Playing the Partum
videos.overview: Struggling to juggle work and being a mother, Mrs. Adler accepts help from Ms. Cannon, which she quickly regrets. Ms. Snap leads a group of Wilderness Gals through the urban jungle to teach them what it means to be a modern woman.

videos.title: Sidelined
videos.overview: Hot Dad surprises Ms. Bennigan with a visit from her parents, only to realize there is much she hasn't told them. The Teachers of Fillmore vie to be champions of Fillmore Fantasy School.

videos.title: Face Your Peers
videos.overview: Mrs. Adler joins a children's music group and is too ashamed to tell the other teachers. Ms. Watson and Ms. Bennigan find their classes passing notes, which causes a rift in their friendship.

videos.title: Relationslut
videos.overview: Ms. Snap helps Ms. Watson find her inner floozy while simultaneously getting into a relationship of her own. Mrs. Adler and Toby try to teach their students about the effects of bullying.

videos.title: The Final Robe
videos.overview: Ms. Bennigan has two spots left in her bridal party and the three remaining teachers compete to see who will get the final robe. Ms. Watson gets an unfortunate diagnosis.

videos.title: The Tell-Tale Cart
videos.overview: It's Valentine's Day at Fillmore Elementary School. Ms. Snap and Kyle have trouble communicating. The school is falling apart, and Mrs. Adler makes the repairs herself; Ms. Bennigan deals with a pesky TV cart salesman.

videos.title: Teacher Depreciation Week
videos.overview: Stricter mandates are required of the teachers. Ms. Bennigan attempts to balance being a teacher and a future stepmother. With no funding, Mrs. Adler, Ms. Watson and Ms. Cannon go to extreme lengths to raise funds for their classrooms.

videos.title: Wedded Miss
videos.overview: It's Ms. Bennigan's wedding day, and everything that can go wrong does. The teachers scramble to save this hot mess of a day without Ms. Bennigan finding out.
